Container.Name: VynodeArr
Container.Overview: Manage Radarr-backed movies and Sonarr-backed television from one secure VynodeArr dashboard while each engine keeps its own database and settings. Includes library management, automatic and interactive searches, queues, history, wanted media, calendars, collections, discovery, poster overlays, backups, and guided service configuration.
Container.Description:
VynodeArr is a unified, self-hosted movie and television library manager built for Unraid. The container includes installation-managed Radarr and Sonarr engines behind one VynodeArr gateway; their databases, settings, queues, logs, and persistent data remain isolated.
First start: select separate movie and television shares, the completed-download share used by your download client, and a persistent appdata location. Open the Web UI and create the first administrator account. Indexers, download clients, discovery, notifications, Plex, Reeltrack, and other services are configured inside VynodeArr.
Existing libraries are supported. Back up /config before upgrades or removal. Radarr and Sonarr remain GPLv3 software maintained by their respective contributors. VynodeArr code is licensed under Apache 2.0; full component versions, source links, and notices are included in the image.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: radarr sonarr movies television tv media manager library requests posters overlays
Container.Changes: 2.0.39: Added lightweight Plex-first hero video previews with fallback providers, corrected movie and television sorting, restored library scroll position after viewing details, and refreshed Community Applications metadata.
Container.Requires: Requires an x86-64 Unraid server with Docker. Appdata, movie, television, and completed-download paths must be writable by nobody:users (99:100). The download-client remote path must match the path reported by that client so VynodeArr can translate it to /downloads.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port used to open the VynodeArr web interface and compatibility APIs.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent VynodeArr accounts, settings, backups, and isolated engine databases. Back up this folder before removal.

Config.Name: Movie library
Config.Description: Host share containing movie folders. Keep this container path as /movies.

Config.Name: Television library
Config.Description: Host share containing television series folders. Keep this container path as /tv.

Config.Name: Completed downloads
Config.Description: Completed-download share accessible to VynodeArr and your download client. Keep this container path as /downloads.

Config.Name: Unraid template access
Config.Description: Allows the guarded storage wizard to add path entries only to VynodeArr's own user template. The app validates the complete XML and writes atomically; it cannot apply or restart the container. Remove this mapping if you do not want in-app template editing.

Config.Name: Download client remote path
Config.Description: Container path reported by the download client for completed files, for example /data/complete. VynodeArr maps it to /downloads.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for schedules and displayed dates, for example America/New_York.

Config.Name: TMDB read token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional token for Discover during first start. It can be added or replaced later under Service Settings.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Set to true only when every browser connection reaches VynodeArr through HTTPS.
